info.name: Advanced Webforms
info.summary: Forms with conditional logic, grid layouts, and after-submit actions
info.description:
**A form builder with the features larger form tools have, on your own server.**
- **Builder:** drag and drop fields onto a 12-column grid with a live preview. Text, email, phone, number, date, time, select, radio, checkboxes, rating, scale, consent, hidden fields, file uploads, headings, paragraphs and images. - **Rules engine:** show, hide, or require fields based on earlier answers, with nested AND/OR conditions. Checked again on the server. - **Multi-page forms:** progress indicator, an optional summary step before sending, and optional "continue later" that keeps unsent answers in the respondent's own browser. - **After-submit actions:** confirmation message, redirect, email, signed webhook, a row in Nextcloud Tables, or a line in a CSV file in your Files. Each can have conditions and is retried in the background. - **Responses:** browse, filter by status, add a note, see the delivery log, and download a CSV. New responses are marked for you. - **Sharing:** public link, custom address, QR code and embedding in a frame, with spam protection that keeps your visitors' data on your server. - **Flow integration** and server-wide administration settings.
Forms and responses stay on your server. Requires Nextcloud 35.
info.author: Adam Arcane
